98070886.s: A bakery serving a wide, appetizing range of pastries and sweets since 1985.
98070886.b: Neamah is a bakery serving a wide, appetizing range of pastries and sweets since 1985. It is one of the longest-established bakeries in Jeddah, with decades of experience and fresh products made daily, although some reviews suggest customer service could be improved. Contact: 920000679. Open daily from 7:00 AM to 12:00 midnight.

98070885.s: A spot for crepe lovers, serving crepes in many inventive flavors.
98070885.b: Creperie De Marbella is a place for crepe lovers, serving crepes in many creative flavors. It is known for its Nutella crepe and spicy crepe with pesto sauce, and offers stylish indoor seating and comfortable outdoor seating, along with refreshing cold drinks such as hibiscus. Contact: 0502077676. Open daily from 10:30 AM to 3:00 AM.
98070885.a: King Abdulaziz Road, Az Zahraa, Jeddah 23424

98070884.s: Famous for some of the best pancakes in Jeddah, plus French toast, desserts and baked goods.
98070884.b: Siblings is known for serving some of the best pancakes in Jeddah, as well as French toast prepared in a distinctive and appetizing way, and many desserts and baked goods. It is best known for its soufflé pancakes, which visitors praise highly, and it offers a small game in which you can win a free sorbet as a fun touch. Contact: 0559181286. Open from 7:00 AM to 11:00 PM (until midnight on Thursday and Friday).
98070884.a: 2603 Al Imam Malik, Ar Rawdah, Jeddah 23435

98070883.s: A bakery that lets you play the baker, alongside coffee and delicious pastries.
98070883.b: Bread Ahead Bakery & School offers a bread-making experience so you can play the baker, as well as coffee and delicious pastries. It is known for its turkey bagel sandwich and cheese shakshuka, and runs real baking workshops led by professional chefs for those who want to learn the craft. Contact: 0538434670. Open daily from 7:00 AM to 12:00 midnight.
98070883.a: King Abdulaziz Road, Az Zahraa, Jeddah 23424

98070882.s: A specialist in a wide range of cakes and desserts made daily, plus coffee.
98070882.b: Ganache specializes in a wide range of cakes and desserts made daily, along with coffee. It is known for its cloud mango cake and rich chocolate cake, and is a well-known luxury Saudi brand recognized for the high quality of its products and exceptional service. Contact: 920019960. Open daily from 9:00 AM to 1:30 AM.
98070882.a: Prince Saud Al Faisal Road, Ar Rawdah, Jeddah 23432

98070881.s: Enjoy the aroma of coffee in a warm setting, with a wide variety of tempting desserts.
98070881.b: Sucre de Nada invites you to enjoy the aroma of coffee in a warm atmosphere, alongside a wide and varied menu of tempting desserts. It is known for its famous apple pie and crème caramel, and earns excellent reviews for the quality of its cakes, especially the coconut and chocolate cakes, although there are occasional comments about the service. Contact: 0505286861. Open daily from 10:00 AM to 11:00 PM (until midnight on weekends).

98070879.s: One of the best-known restaurants for Japanese cuisine, with a wide sushi menu.
98070879.b: Tokyo Restaurant is one of the best-known places for Japanese dishes, with a wide menu of delicious sushi. It is known for its truffle amberjack tuna, special Tokyo rice and slices of Japanese wagyu beef, and offers exceptional service and a menu that changes with the season. Contact: 920009662. Open daily from 1:00 PM to 12:00 midnight.
98070879.a: 3605 King Abdulaziz Road, Al Muhammadiyah, Jeddah 23617

98070877.s: A distinctive restaurant serving fine international dishes in one place, plus coffee and desserts.
98070877.b: Agave Restaurant & Cafe is a distinctive restaurant offering fine international dishes in one place, along with coffee and delicious desserts. It has a stunning rooftop view over Jeddah and a live-music atmosphere, and is a great spot for taking photos, especially at sunset. Contact: 0552361616. Open daily from 1:00 PM to 2:00 AM.
98070877.a: King Abdulaziz Branch Road, South Abhur, Jeddah 23734

98070875.s: The ideal place for lovers of authentic Italian flavors, specializing in many Italian dishes.
98070875.b: Olive Garden is the ideal place for lovers of authentic Italian flavors, specializing in a wide range of Italian dishes. It is known for its bread, soup and varied pasta, and earns excellent reviews for its service and friendly family atmosphere. Contact: 0597485555. Open daily from 12:00 PM to 2:00 AM.
98070875.a: Atelier La Vie, King Abdulaziz Road, Ash Shati, Jeddah 23514

98070874.s: A distinctive luxury restaurant from France serving delicious dishes with seaside seating.
98070874.b: Le Vesuvio is a distinctive luxury restaurant that comes from France to serve delicious dishes with wonderful seating by the sea. It is known for its authentic truffle pizza and parmigiano lasagna, hosts live music every Thursday, and offers a great sunset view. Open daily from 5:00 PM to 2:00 AM.
98070874.a: 7190 Corniche Branch Road, Ash Shati, Jeddah 23613

98070873.s: One of the best Indian restaurants, serving delicious naan bread and many other dishes.
98070873.b: 5 Rivers is one of the best Indian restaurants, serving delicious naan bread alongside many other appetizing dishes. It is known for its lamb ribs and chicken almond soup, and has refined decor that includes indoor plants, although some reviews mention small portions relative to the prices. Contact: 0508265666. Open daily from 12:00 PM to 12:00 midnight.

98070872.s: A Turkish restaurant serving the finest Turkish and Arabic food with authentic flavors.
98070872.b: Khayal is a Turkish restaurant serving the finest Turkish and Arabic dishes with authentic flavors, and it offers complimentary bread, appetizers, olives and a welcome sauce with every meal. It is known for its comforting lentil soup and freshly grilled dishes, and is one of the most popular and busiest restaurants in Jeddah. Contact: 920002223. Open daily from 6:00 AM to 3:00 AM.
98070872.a: Prince Sultan Road, Az Zahraa, Jeddah 23522

98070871.s: A restaurant specializing in original-style pizza with unique flavors and a wide range of inventive sauces.
98070871.b: Somosays Pizza specializes in original-style pizza with unique flavors, alongside a wide selection of inventive sauces. It is known for its Buffalo pizza and generous appetizer box, and has a warm atmosphere and attractive lighting that make it a favorite to return to. Contact: 0555664725. Open daily from 12:00 PM to 4:00 AM.
98070871.a: Box Park Center, Al Batarji, Az Zahraa, Jeddah 23522

98070869.s: For lovers of authentic Japanese flavor, with a sushi conveyor belt and many other dishes.
98070869.b: Keiken is for lovers of authentic Japanese flavor, offering a sushi conveyor belt alongside many other appetizing dishes. It offers an open sushi deal at a fixed price (129 riyals) that includes many kinds of crab, tuna, salmon and shrimp, and lets guests watch the chefs prepare the food live. Contact: 0555041624. Open daily from 1:00 PM to 1:00 AM.
98070869.a: 6370 Prince Sultan Road, Az Zahraa, Jeddah 23424

98070868.s: Enjoy flavorful Indian spices alongside many Arabic dishes.
98070868.b: Chai Maloom offers the enjoyment of flavorful Indian spices alongside many Arabic dishes. It opens very early, from dawn, and is known for the signature tea that carries its name. It is popular among those who love Indian flavors blended with a local, casual character. Contact: 0553382166. Open daily from 4:30 AM to 12:00 midnight.

98070867.s: For lovers of Asian flavors, serving a variety of inventively prepared Asian dishes.
98070867.b: Da Bao, in the Ar Rawdah district of Jeddah, is a destination for lovers of Asian flavors, serving a variety of Asian dishes prepared in an inventive and appetizing way. It is located in Rovan Tower on Prince Saud Al Faisal Road. Contact: 0565161760. Open daily from 1:00 PM to 2:00 AM.
98070867.a: Rovan Tower, Prince Saud Al Faisal Road, Ar Rawdah, Jeddah 23433

98070866.s: A restaurant and cafe serving delicious Arabic dishes in a warm, homely atmosphere.
98070866.b: Jaw is a restaurant and cafe serving delicious Arabic dishes in a warm atmosphere with a homely feel. It is known for its tiramisu and karak tea, hosts live music evenings with a singer, and requires advance booking with a minimum order. Contact: 0562101019. Open daily from 8:00 PM to 2:00 AM.
98070866.a: Prince Mohammed bin Abdulaziz Road, Al Andalus, Jeddah 23322

98070865.s: A wide and varied menu of tasty dishes for different tastes, in a lovely setting.
98070865.b: La Calle offers a wide and varied menu of tasty dishes for every taste in a lovely setting. It is known for its seafood paella, wasabi shrimp and lobster pieces, and earns excellent reviews as one of the best Spanish restaurants in Jeddah. Contact: 0562861562. Open daily from 7:00 AM to 1:00 PM and from 2:00 PM to 12:00 midnight.
98070865.a: Prince Sultan Road, Link B Building, First Floor, Ar Rawdah, Jeddah 23431

98070864.s: A restaurant with a striking sea view and a varied menu.
98070864.b: Blue Ocean is a restaurant with a striking sea view and a varied menu that includes American and seafood dishes. It is known for its breakfast wrap and steak fajita omelet, and offers friendly service and reasonable prices considering the location and quality. Contact: 0533056605. Open daily from 7:00 AM to 1:00 AM.
98070864.a: Corniche Branch Road, Ash Shati, Jeddah 23413

98070863.s: A long-established Italian restaurant since 1976, known for pizza and classic Italian dishes.
98070863.b: IL Castello is a long-established Italian restaurant, open since 1976, known for pizza and classic Italian dishes with a Lebanese touch, and is one of Jeddah's enduring landmarks. It features an old-castle decor adorned with antique shields and swords that has not changed since it opened nearly 50 years ago, and it holds childhood memories for generations of Jeddah residents. Contact: 0126606119. Open daily from 1:00 PM to 3:30 PM and from 6:00 PM to 12:00 midnight.

98070862.s: Known for its delicious chimichurri steak and many other dishes in a lovely atmosphere.
98070862.b: Tapas is known for its delicious chimichurri steak alongside many other appetizing dishes in a lovely atmosphere. It is known for its date dessert, burrata and beetroot salad, and has luxurious spaces suited to special occasions, although prices are relatively high for the portion sizes. Contact: 0563166593. Open daily from 12:30 PM to 1:00 AM.

98070861.s: A distinctive Lebanese restaurant with a lovely atmosphere and authentic Lebanese food.
98070861.b: Shababik is a distinctive Lebanese restaurant with a lovely atmosphere and authentic Lebanese food, and is considered one of the best Lebanese destinations in Jeddah. It is known for its raw meat dishes and for a dish regarded as the best of its kind, and offers professional service and a refined ambiance, although prices are relatively high. Contact: 920003945. Open daily from 12:30 PM to 1:00 AM (until 9:00 AM on Saturday).
98070861.a: Ana Special Complex, Prince Sultan Road, Ar Rawdah, Jeddah 23431

98070860.s: A traditional Japanese restaurant serving the finest authentic sushi.
98070860.b: Wakame is a traditional Japanese restaurant serving the finest authentic sushi. It is known for its spicy crab salad and truffle shrimp dough, and earns excellent reviews for the quality of its food and exceptional service from a multinational team. Contact: 920005036. Open daily from 12:00 PM to 12:30 AM.
98070860.a: King Abdulaziz Road, Az Zahraa, Jeddah 23424

98070859.s: A long-established Italian restaurant serving authentic Italian cuisine.
98070859.b: Al Dente is a long-established Italian restaurant serving authentic Italian cuisine in an elegant mountain-lodge setting that evokes a forest canopy. It is known for its excellent tomato soup and rich pasta, and is highly rated as one of the best Italian restaurants, with a warm and comfortable decor. Contact: 0126970220. Open daily from 1:00 PM to 12:30 AM.
98070859.a: Prince Sultan Road, As Salamah, Jeddah 23436

98070858.s: A restaurant with a distinctive, varied menu including beef, bao and noodles.
98070858.b: Baco is a restaurant with a distinctive and varied menu that includes beef, bao and noodles in a modern Asian style. It is known for its Asian and Mexican potato dishes and stuffed bao, and has an elegant, comfortable atmosphere, although some reviews note smaller portions than at similar restaurants. Contact: 0500034378. Open daily from 1:00 PM to 1:00 AM.
